pr_title: Fix crash in TabContainer in case of no content at all
pr_body:
<!--
Pull requests should always be made for the `master` branch first, as that's
where development happens and the source of all future stable release branches.

Relevant fixes are cherry-picked for stable branches as needed.

Do not create a pull request for stable branches unless the change is already
available in the `master` branch and it cannot be easily cherry-picked.
Alternatively, if the change is only relevant for that branch (e.g. rendering
fixes for the 3.2 branch).
-->
Fix #43165

It was safe in previous logic because all tabs are drawn in for loop.
But the regression is caused by drawing selected tab is out of loop.

> also in 3.2.4(PR - #43162, but seems that not always crash)

No longer as I reverted the cherry-pick for now.

review_comments: Can you simply check if `tabs.size() > 0` then ? This check is quite weird, because outside of the case where the size is 0, this condition is always true.
Shouldn't we abort way earlier if `tabs.size()` is 0? Is there actually anything to draw beside an empty header?
Yes, that would likely be cleaner, I agree.

tab area should be drawn at previous line to draw in correct order of tabs and content area.
```
line 372 : panel->draw(canvas, Rect2(0, header_height, size.width, size.height - header_height));
```
so I think `tab.size() > 0` would be best option.
